Main.dc.html.title: Today: a tap on the switch closes the sheet

After.dc.html.title: Proposed: after a tap, the sheet stays up and the switch reads Off

title.text: T54 · Contents' switch flips in place

legend.text:
What changes: a tap on Bring moments back leaves the Contents sheet up; the switch moves to off in place and its note reads Off. Close, a tap on the dimmed page, or Escape leave the sheet, as now. The page behind changes as it does today (the resurfaced slip goes while the switch is off).

Rests on: ui-patterns, "a status that needs no action sits inline" (F4); NN/g H1, visibility of system status; Layers and What I'm into keep their sheets up as a switch flips.

What it does not do: no new word, count, colour or control. The sheet is the one T53 shipped.
